title_zh: 约定暂放反复修改的照片

scenario.label_zh: 约定暂放反复修改的照片
scenario.goal_zh: 听取反复修图带来的烦恼，并约定先停止编辑、出去散步

context_zh: 两个朋友讨论一张业余摄影作品；对话不作心理诊断。
author: author-phase11-c

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: I’ve changed the colors in this photo twelve times. It’s becoming an obsession, and I’m not enjoying it anymore.

sentences.speaker: Nia
sentences.text: What happens when you leave it alone for a while?

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: I start to obsess over the tiny details again. I keep thinking one bad photo means I’m no good at this.

sentences.speaker: Nia
sentences.text: That last part is nonsense. You’ve made plenty of pictures you like, and this one doesn’t decide anything about you.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: I know. I’m making myself miserable over a hobby that used to help me unwind.

sentences.speaker: Nia
sentences.text: Then let’s stop the misery for tonight. Save a copy, close the editor, and come for a walk with me.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: All right. I’ll leave the photo as it is tonight and get my coat.

targets.sense_zh: 反复困扰自己；过分挂心
